test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Doctor Bayley __tripped under some large roots and cuts__ her head on a rock.

options.text: tripped over some large roots and cut
tripped over and above some large roots and cut
tripped upon some larger roots and cuts

solution:
The correct answer is **"****tripped over some large roots and cut**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"****tripped over some large roots and cut"** can improve the underlined part of the sentence.
 
• We use the verb phrase -**"****to trip over something**" to mean - **" to fall over,** to stumble on, to slip on something". 
 
 
• **Example: **The road was too bumpy that I** tripped over** it so many times.
 
 
 
• The verb **"cut" **is an irregular verb, which means that **"cut"** does not form its simple present (by adding 's' to the base form) tense or its simple past / past participle by adding "-ed" or "-d" to the base form).
 
 
• **Example:** He** cut** trees and sells it in the market.
 
 
 
• Thus,*** option 2) ***is the correct alternative.

**The correct sentence:** Doctor Bayley tripped over some large roots and cut__ her head on a rock.
